name: forocoching
description: Extensión para ForoCoches con filtrado de hilos, usuarios ignorados, editor social y clasificador con IA multi-proveedor.

scripts.dev: cross-env WATCH=true concurrently "vite build --config vite.config.bg.ts --watch" "vite build --config vite.config.cs.ts --watch"
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.config.bg.ts && vite build --config vite.config.cs.ts && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --config vite.config.bg.ts && vite build --config vite.config.cs.ts && node scripts/package.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --config vite.config.bg.ts && vite build --config vite.config.cs.ts && node scripts/package.mjs firefox
